_label: PROJECT-AUTHORED REFERENCE DATA — prototype practical-task bank derived from the official learning outcomes and assessment criteria of QF ELECTRICIAN (DGT/1001, NSQF 4). The quoted qf_criterion_ref strings are verbatim from the QF; task design, steps, weights and score anchors are project design decisions, not official requirements.

tasks.title: Identify trade tools, wires and electrical components
tasks.description: From a tray of common tools, wires and accessories, name each item, say what it is used for, and check tools for damage before use.
tasks.description_hi: ट्रे में रखे औज़ार, तार और पुर्ज़ों का नाम बताएं, उनका काम बताएं, और इस्तेमाल से पहले औज़ार की जाँच करें।

steps.en: Pick up each tool and say its name and use.
steps.hi: हर औज़ार उठाकर उसका नाम और काम बताएं।

steps.en: Sort the wires by size and type; read the marking on one cable.
steps.hi: तारों को साइज़ और प्रकार से अलग करें; एक केबल पर लिखी जानकारी पढ़ें।

steps.en: Check the screwdriver and plier insulation for cracks.
steps.hi: पेचकस और प्लायर की इंसुलेशन में दरार जाँचें।

evidence_required.what: Tools and components laid out and labelled by the candidate
Cable marking / wire gauge being read

safety_requirements: Damaged or un-insulated tools must be set aside, not used

criteria.text: Names common trade tools and states their correct use
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO1: Identify the trade tools; demonstrate their uses with safety, care & maintenance.

anchors.1: Names fewer than half; needs prompting
anchors.2: Names most but confuses uses of 2 or more
anchors.3: Names all, one minor confusion of use
anchors.4: Names all and explains use and care without prompting

criteria.text: Identifies wire and cable types and reads their specification
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO3: Identify types of wires, cables and verify their specifications.

anchors.1: Distinguishes only by colour; cannot read size
anchors.2: Identifies type but misreads size/rating
anchors.3: Correct type and size, hesitant on rating/application
anchors.4: Correct type, size, rating and suitable application

criteria.text: Inspects tools for damaged insulation before use and rejects unsafe tools
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO1: Identify the trade tools; demonstrate their uses with safety, care & maintenance.

anchors.1: Inspects only when told; misses the damaged tool
anchors.2: Inspects but does not set damaged tool aside
anchors.3: Finds and rejects damaged tool after a prompt
anchors.4: Inspects unprompted and rejects the damaged tool

criteria.evidence_hint: Observation note / photo of rejected tool

tasks.title: Safety preparation and supply isolation
tasks.title_hi: सुरक्षा तैयारी और सप्लाई बंद करना
tasks.description: Prepare to work on a live installation: wear protective equipment, switch off and isolate the supply, and prove it is dead before touching conductors.
tasks.description_hi: काम शुरू करने से पहले सुरक्षा उपकरण पहनें, मेन सप्लाई बंद करें, और तार छूने से पहले टेस्टर से जाँच लें कि करंट नहीं है।

steps.en: Put on insulated gloves and safety shoes.
steps.hi: इंसुलेटेड दस्ताने और सेफ्टी जूते पहनें।

steps.en: Switch off the main switch / MCB and put a warning tag.
steps.hi: मेन स्विच / MCB बंद करें और चेतावनी टैग लगाएं।

steps.en: Test with a tester on a known live point, then on the circuit, then again on the live point.
steps.hi: टेस्टर को पहले चालू पॉइंट पर, फिर सर्किट पर, फिर दोबारा चालू पॉइंट पर जाँचें।

steps.en: Keep the work area clean and dry.
steps.hi: काम की जगह साफ़ और सूखी रखें।

evidence_required.what: Candidate wearing PPE at the work point

safety_requirements: No work on conductors before prove-dead test

criteria.text: Selects and wears appropriate PPE for the task
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Comply with safety & IE rules when performing the wiring.

anchors.1: PPE worn only after instruction, incomplete
anchors.2: Some PPE worn unprompted, item missing
anchors.3: Full PPE, worn correctly after a reminder on one item
anchors.4: Full, correct PPE unprompted throughout

criteria.evidence_hint: Photo showing gloves/footwear at work point

criteria.text: Isolates the supply and proves dead before touching conductors
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Comply with safety & IE rules when performing the wiring.

anchors.1: Isolates only when told; no prove-dead test
anchors.2: Isolates but tests only the circuit (tester not proven)
anchors.3: Isolates and proves dead; omits tag or second check
anchors.4: Isolates, tags, proves tester-circuit-tester before work

criteria.evidence_hint: Photo of tagged isolator; optional video of test

criteria.text: Keeps work area clean, dry and tools organised
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: QF §24 formative dimension: Workplace hygiene (5%)

anchors.2: Mostly tidy; offcuts left on floor
anchors.3: Tidy with minor lapse
anchors.4: Clean, dry, tools returned and offcuts cleared

tasks.title: Wire joints, crimping and soldering
tasks.description: Make a straight twist joint and a rat-tail joint, terminate a cable lug with a crimping tool, and solder one joint safely.
tasks.description_hi: सीधा ट्विस्ट जोड़ और रैट-टेल जोड़ बनाएं, क्रिम्पिंग टूल से केबल लग लगाएं, और एक जोड़ को सुरक्षित तरीके से सोल्डर करें।

steps.en: Strip insulation to the right length without nicking the copper.
steps.hi: कॉपर को काटे बिना सही लंबाई तक इंसुलेशन छीलें।

steps.en: Make the straight twist and rat-tail joints.
steps.hi: सीधा ट्विस्ट और रैट-टेल जोड़ बनाएं।

steps.en: Crimp a lug on the cable end and pull-test it.
steps.hi: केबल के सिरे पर लग क्रिम्प करें और खींचकर जाँचें।

steps.en: Solder one joint and insulate it.
steps.hi: एक जोड़ सोल्डर करें और उस पर इंसुलेशन लगाएं।

safety_requirements: Soldering iron on stand when not in use

criteria.text: Makes straight twist and rat-tail joints that are tight and correctly formed
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO2: Make simple straight twist and rat-tail joints in single strand conductors.

anchors.1: Loose joint, needs re-doing with help
anchors.2: One joint acceptable, one loose or nicked
anchors.3: Both tight; minor unevenness of turns
anchors.4: Both tight, even turns, no nicked copper

criteria.text: Terminates a cable lug using a crimping tool; termination passes pull test
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO2: Prepare termination of cable lugs by using crimping tool.

anchors.2: Crimped but strands outside barrel or fails pull test
anchors.3: Passes pull test; minor strand protrusion
anchors.4: Correct lug and die, clean crimp, passes pull test

criteria.text: Observes precautions while jointing and soldering
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO2: Observe safety/ precaution during joints & soldering.

anchors.1: Repeated unsafe acts corrected by assessor
anchors.2: One unsafe act (e.g. iron left off stand)
anchors.3: Safe throughout after one reminder
anchors.4: Safe throughout unprompted

tasks.title: Wire a switch, socket and lamp circuit on a test board
tasks.title_hi: टेस्ट बोर्ड पर स्विच, सॉकेट और बल्ब की वायरिंग
tasks.description: Plan and wire a board with one switch-controlled lamp and one 6A socket in PVC channel, then test it.
tasks.description_hi: PVC चैनल में एक स्विच से चलने वाला बल्ब और एक 6A सॉकेट वाला बोर्ड बनाएं, फिर उसकी जाँच करें।

steps.en: Mark the layout and list the material you need.
steps.hi: लेआउट बनाएं और ज़रूरी सामान की सूची बनाएं।

steps.en: Fix channel and accessories; run phase, neutral and earth.
steps.hi: चैनल और एक्सेसरीज़ लगाएं; फेज़, न्यूट्रल और अर्थ तार चलाएं।

steps.en: Connect: switch in phase, socket with earth.
steps.hi: जोड़ें: स्विच फेज़ में, सॉकेट में अर्थ।

steps.en: Check with a tester before switching on; then test lamp and socket.
steps.hi: चालू करने से पहले टेस्टर से जाँचें; फिर बल्ब और सॉकेट चलाकर देखें।

evidence_required.what: Material list / estimate (photo of paper is fine)

safety_requirements: Switch must break the phase conductor
Board energised only after assessor permission

criteria.text: Plans the layout and estimates material correctly
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Estimate the cost of material for wiring in PVC channel for an office room having 2 lamps, 1 Fan, one 6A socket outlet and wire up.

anchors.1: Plan only with assistance; large omissions
anchors.2: Plan with 2+ items missing or wrong quantity
anchors.3: Plan complete, one quantity off
anchors.4: Complete layout and accurate material list

criteria.text: Connects correctly: switch in phase, neutral direct to load, socket earthed
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO1: Make and wire up of a test board and test it.

anchors.0: Circuit unsafe (switch in neutral or no earth)
anchors.1: Wrong connections corrected only with step-by-step help
anchors.2: Works but one non-safety error (e.g. polarity at lamp holder)
anchors.3: All safety connections correct; minor termination issue
anchors.4: All connections correct and verified by candidate

criteria.evidence_hint: Photo of open switch and socket terminals

criteria.text: Neat workmanship: secure terminations, no exposed copper, channel fixed straight
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO1: Demonstrate fixing of surface mounting type of accessories.

anchors.2: Functional but untidy; some copper exposed
anchors.3: Neat with one minor defect
anchors.4: Neat, straight, all terminations tight and covered

criteria.text: Tests the circuit before and after energising
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO1: Make and wire up of a test board and test it.

anchors.2: Functional test only, no pre-energise check
anchors.3: Pre- and post-checks with one omission
anchors.4: Continuity/polarity check before, functional test after

tasks.title: Measurement and continuity testing with a multimeter
tasks.title_hi: मल्टीमीटर से माप और कंटिन्युटी जाँच
tasks.description: Use a digital multimeter to check continuity of a cable, measure a resistance, and measure supply voltage safely; record the readings.
tasks.description_hi: डिजिटल मल्टीमीटर से केबल की कंटिन्युटी, रेज़िस्टेंस और सप्लाई वोल्टेज सुरक्षित तरीके से मापें और रीडिंग लिखें।

steps.en: Choose the right setting on the meter for each test.
steps.hi: हर जाँच के लिए मीटर पर सही सेटिंग चुनें।

steps.en: Check continuity of the given cable cores.
steps.hi: दिए गए केबल के तारों की कंटिन्युटी जाँचें।

steps.en: Measure the supply voltage holding probes safely.
steps.hi: प्रोब सुरक्षित पकड़कर सप्लाई वोल्टेज मापें।

steps.en: Write down every reading with its unit.
steps.hi: हर रीडिंग यूनिट के साथ लिखें।

safety_requirements: Meter set to voltage before probing live terminals

criteria.text: Selects the correct function and range on the multimeter
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO8: Measure the value of resistance, voltage and current using digital multimeter.

anchors.1: Sets meter only with step-by-step help
anchors.2: Correct for 1 of 3 measurements
anchors.3: Correct for all after one self-correction
anchors.4: Correct function and range first time for all

criteria.text: Performs continuity test and correctly interprets open/short result
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO17: Test continuity and insulation of various AC motors.

anchors.2: Interprets one core correctly, misses open core
anchors.3: All cores correct, hesitant explanation
anchors.4: All cores correct with clear explanation of open/short

criteria.text: Measures live voltage safely (correct setting before probing, fingers behind guards)
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO8: Measure the value of resistance, voltage and current using digital multimeter.

anchors.0: Probes live terminal on resistance/current range
anchors.2: Safe setting but poor probe handling
anchors.3: Safe with one reminder
anchors.4: Safe setting and handling throughout

criteria.text: Records readings with correct units
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: QF §24 formative dimension: Ability to follow Manuals/ Written instructions (5%)

anchors.2: Readings recorded, units missing
anchors.3: Complete with one unit error
anchors.4: Complete and correct

tasks.title: Locate and repair a fault in domestic wiring
tasks.title_hi: घरेलू वायरिंग में खराबी ढूँढना और ठीक करना
tasks.description: A fault has been placed in a domestic wiring board (e.g. open neutral or loose switch terminal). Find it systematically, repair it, and re-test.
tasks.description_hi: घरेलू वायरिंग बोर्ड में एक खराबी डाली गई है (जैसे न्यूट्रल टूटा या स्विच टर्मिनल ढीला)। उसे क्रम से ढूँढें, ठीक करें और दोबारा जाँचें।

steps.en: Ask what the problem is and observe the symptom.
steps.hi: समस्या पूछें और लक्षण देखें।

steps.en: Isolate the supply before opening any accessory.
steps.hi: कोई भी एक्सेसरी खोलने से पहले सप्लाई बंद करें।

steps.en: Test section by section from supply to load.
steps.hi: सप्लाई से लोड तक हिस्सा-हिस्सा जाँचें।

steps.en: Repair, re-test and explain the cause.
steps.hi: ठीक करें, दोबारा जाँचें और कारण बताएं।

criteria.text: Follows a systematic diagnosis (symptom, supply to load, half-split)
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Test, locate the fault and repair a domestic wiring installation.

anchors.1: Needs assessor to direct each step
anchors.2: Some logic but skips sections
anchors.3: Systematic with one redundant step
anchors.4: Clear systematic sequence, explains reasoning

criteria.text: Correctly locates the placed fault
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Test, locate the fault and repair a domestic wiring installation.

anchors.2: Found the area, not the exact point
anchors.3: Found exact point after one wrong guess
anchors.4: Found exact point directly

criteria.text: Repairs the fault and re-tests before handing back
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Test, locate the fault and repair a domestic wiring installation.

anchors.2: Repaired, functional test only
anchors.3: Repaired and re-tested; minor finish issue
anchors.4: Repaired neatly, re-tested, explains cause to customer

criteria.text: Works with supply isolated while repairing
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Comply with safety & IE rules when performing the wiring.

anchors.2: Isolates but does not prove dead
anchors.3: Isolates and proves dead after reminder
anchors.4: Isolates and proves dead unprompted

tasks.title: Circuit protection: fuse, MCB and ELCB/RCCB
tasks.title_hi: सर्किट सुरक्षा: फ्यूज़, MCB और ELCB/RCCB
tasks.description: Choose the correct fuse/MCB rating for a given load, install an MCB in a distribution board, and check ELCB/RCCB operation.
tasks.description_hi: दिए गए लोड के लिए सही फ्यूज़/MCB रेटिंग चुनें, डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन बोर्ड में MCB लगाएं, और ELCB/RCCB की जाँच करें।

steps.en: Calculate current for the given load and choose the MCB rating.
steps.hi: दिए गए लोड का करंट निकालें और MCB रेटिंग चुनें।

steps.en: Mount and connect the MCB in the board.
steps.hi: बोर्ड में MCB लगाकर जोड़ें।

steps.en: Press the test button on the ELCB/RCCB and explain what it protects against.
steps.hi: ELCB/RCCB का टेस्ट बटन दबाएं और बताएं कि यह किससे बचाता है।

criteria.text: Selects correct fuse/MCB rating for the given load
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Identify the types of fuses their ratings and applications.

anchors.2: Rating off by one step without reason
anchors.3: Correct rating, calculation slightly wrong
anchors.4: Correct calculation and rating with justification

criteria.text: Installs MCB in the distribution board correctly
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Identify the parts of a relay, MCB & ELCB and check its operation.

anchors.2: Installed; loose terminal or wrong busbar side
anchors.3: Correct; minor finish issue
anchors.4: Correct, tight, labelled

criteria.text: Checks ELCB/RCCB operation and explains earth-leakage protection
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO27: Identify parts of circuit breaker and check its operation.

anchors.2: Tests but explanation wrong
anchors.3: Tests and explains with minor gap
anchors.4: Tests, explains leakage protection and when to test

tasks.title: Read a wiring diagram and derive materials
tasks.title_hi: वायरिंग डायग्राम पढ़ना और सामान निकालना
tasks.description: Given a domestic wiring diagram (consumer main board with ICDP switch and distribution board), identify the symbols, trace the circuit and list the material required. Short viva.
tasks.description_hi: घरेलू वायरिंग डायग्राम (ICDP स्विच और डिस्ट्रीब्यूशन बोर्ड वाला मेन बोर्ड) देखकर चिन्ह पहचानें, सर्किट समझाएं और ज़रूरी सामान की सूची बनाएं। छोटा मौखिक प्रश्न।

steps.en: Name each symbol in the diagram.
steps.hi: डायग्राम में हर चिन्ह का नाम बताएं।

steps.en: Trace the path from the meter to a light point.
steps.hi: मीटर से लाइट पॉइंट तक का रास्ता बताएं।

steps.en: Make the material list from the diagram.
steps.hi: डायग्राम से सामान की सूची बनाएं।

steps.en: Answer the assessor's questions about how the circuit works.
steps.hi: सर्किट कैसे काम करता है, इस पर पूछे गए सवालों के जवाब दें।

criteria.text: Identifies standard electrical symbols in the diagram
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO12: Read & interpret the information on drawings and apply in executing practical work.

anchors.2: Most, confuses switchgear symbols
anchors.3: All but one
anchors.4: All symbols correct

criteria.text: Traces the circuit path and sequence of protective devices
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO5: Draw and wire up the consumers main board with ICDP switch and distribution fuse box.

anchors.2: Traces path, wrong device order
anchors.3: Correct with hesitation
anchors.4: Correct path and device sequence, explains why

criteria.text: Derives material requirement from the drawing
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: LO12: Read &analyze the specification to ascertain the material requirement, tools and assembly/maintenance parameters.

anchors.2: List with 2+ omissions
anchors.3: List complete, one quantity off
anchors.4: Complete, correct list

criteria.text: Viva: explains how the circuit works and why protection is placed where it is
criteria.qf_criterion_ref: QF §24 formative dimension: VIVA (15%)

anchors.2: Partly correct
anchors.3: Correct, minor gaps
anchors.4: Correct and complete in own words
